blocks.prompt: 3 (a) Express the following: The area \(A\) of a square as a function of its perimeter \(P\).
blocks.explanation:
"\(A\) ko \(P\) ke function ke taur par likhein" ka matlab hai aisa formula jis mein right side par sirf \(P\) ho, koi aur letter nahi.
Diya kya hai? Square (murabba), jis ka area \(A\) aur perimeter (ird gird ki lambai) \(P\) hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(A\) sirf \(P\) mein.
Plan: dono ko side \(s\) se likhna (side hamara "madadgaar letter" hai), \(P\) se \(s\) nikalna, phir \(A\) mein rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: square jis ki side \(s\) hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(A\) sirf \(P\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: \(P = 4s\) aur \(A = s^2\) dono jaane pehchane formulas hain. Ek se \(s\) nikal kar doosre mein rakh denge, to \(s\) khatam ho jayega aur sirf \(P\) bachega.

Dono formulas likhein
\[P = 4s, \qquad A = s^2\]
Kyun: Square ki chaar barabar sides hain, is liye perimeter \(4s\). Area lambai guna chaurai hai, aur dono \(s\) hain, to \(s^2\).

\(s\) ko \(P\) mein likhein
\[s = \dfrac{P}{4}\]
Kyun: \(P = 4s\) ke dono taraf 4 se divide kiya. Misaal: perimeter 20 ho to side 5.

\(A = s^2\) mein rakhein
\[A = \left(\dfrac{P}{4}\right)^2 = \dfrac{P^2}{16}\]
Kyun: Fraction ka square karte waqt upar aur neeche dono ka square hota hai: \(P^2\) aur \(4^2 = 16\).
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{P^2}{4}\) likhna aam ghalti hai; neeche wale 4 ka bhi square hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[s = 3:\; P = 12,\ A = 9\]
\[\dfrac{12^2}{16} = \dfrac{144}{16} = 9 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ek asal square le kar dekha: side 3 ka perimeter 12 aur area 9 hai. Formula mein \(P = 12\) rakha to bhi 9 aaya. Formula sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (b) Express the following: The circumference \(C\) of a circle as a function of its area \(A\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab circle (daaira) hai: circumference \(C\) ko sirf area \(A\) ki shakal mein likhna hai.
Diya kya hai? Circle jis ka radius \(r\) hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(C\) sirf \(A\) mein.
Plan: \(A = \pi r^2\) se \(r\) nikalna, phir \(C = 2\pi r\) mein rakhna, aur root ko saaf karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: circle, radius \(r\).
Humein find karna hai: \(C\) sirf \(A\) mein.
Tareeqa: Dono formulas \(A = \pi r^2\) aur \(C = 2\pi r\) mein \(r\) hai. Radius ko madadgaar letter bana kar khatam karenge.

\(r\) ko \(A\) mein likhein
\[r^2 = \dfrac{A}{\pi}\]
\[r = \sqrt{\dfrac{A}{\pi}}\]
Kyun: Pehle \(\pi\) se divide kiya taake \(r^2\) akela ho, phir square root liya. Radius lambai hai, negative nahi ho sakti, is liye sirf positive root liya.

\(C = 2\pi r\) mein rakhein
\[C = 2\pi\sqrt{\dfrac{A}{\pi}}\]
Kyun: \(r\) ki jagah us ki value rakh di. Ab right side par sirf \(A\) hai (aur \(\pi\), jo ek constant number hai, letter nahi). Jawab sahi hai, lekin abhi aur saaf ho sakta hai.

Simplify karein
\[\pi = \sqrt{\pi^2}\]
\[C = 2\sqrt{\dfrac{\pi^2 A}{\pi}} = 2\sqrt{\pi A}\]
Kyun: Bahar wale \(\pi\) ko root ke andar le jane ke liye us ka square karna parta hai, kyunke \(\sqrt{\pi^2} = \pi\). Andar \(\frac{\pi^2}{\pi} = \pi\) bacha. Is tarah answer key wali shakal \(2\sqrt{\pi A}\) mil gayi.

Tasdeeq
\[r = 1:\; A = \pi,\ C = 2\pi\]
\[2\sqrt{\pi \cdot \pi} = 2\pi \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Radius 1 wale circle ka area \(\pi\) aur circumference \(2\pi\) hai. Formula mein \(A = \pi\) rakha to \(2\pi\) aaya.

blocks.prompt: 3 (c) Express the following: The surface area \(S\) of a cube as a function of its volume \(V\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab cube (mukaab, jaise dice) hai: surface area \(S\) ko volume \(V\) ki shakal mein likhna hai.
Diya kya hai? Cube jis ka edge (kinara) \(a\) hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(S\) sirf \(V\) mein.
Plan: \(V = a^3\) se \(a\) nikalna (cube root), phir \(S = 6a^2\) mein rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: cube, edge \(a\).
Humein find karna hai: \(S\) sirf \(V\) mein.
Tareeqa: \(V = a^3\) aur \(S = 6a^2\). Cube ke 6 faces hain aur har face ek square hai jis ka area \(a^2\) hai, is liye \(S = 6a^2\).

\(a\) ko \(V\) mein likhein
\[a = \sqrt[3]{V} = V^{1/3}\]
Kyun: Cube ko undo karne ke liye cube root lete hain. Cube root ko power \(\frac{1}{3}\) bhi likh sakte hain, jo agle qadam ko aasaan banata hai.

\(S = 6a^2\) mein rakhein
\[S = 6\left(V^{1/3}\right)^2 = 6V^{2/3}\]
Kyun: Power ki power mein powers multiply hoti hain: \(\frac{1}{3} \times 2 = \frac{2}{3}\).
Dhyan dein: \(6V^{2}\) ya \(6V^{1/3}\) likhna ghalat hai; dono powers ko multiply karna hai.

Tasdeeq
\[a = 2:\; V = 8,\ S = 24\]
\[6 \cdot 8^{2/3} = 6 \cdot 4 = 24 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Edge 2 wale cube ka volume 8 aur surface area \(6 \times 4 = 24\). Formula mein \(8^{2/3} = (\sqrt[3]{8})^2 = 2^2 = 4\), aur \(6 \times 4 = 24\). Bilkul theek.
